experiments.title: $1：确认可归因佣金
experiments.action: Recover latest DE/US reports; preserve report dates, currency, shipped/confirmed commission, reversals and payout separately. Obtain a real ECO-exclusive tag before changing links; never invent a tracking ID. Use the private ledger and reconcile shared account totals separately.
experiments.gate: Current 30-day ECO-attributable confirmed net commission >= $1 with dated FX and evidence. Missing evidence stays unknown; no fake orders/self purchases.

experiments.title: $10：验证德国湿度购买路径
experiments.status: existing pages live; focused distribution pack prepared
experiments.action: Use existing cellar, laundry and dehumidifier-guide pages. Preserve the no-purchase outcome for building damage. Review exact model, market, merchant link and sources. Run one bounded distribution task per day through already authorized owned placements; prepare native-language posts for separately authorized channels. Do not rebuild recently shipped tools or launch new countries.
experiments.gate: Operational exposure floor: 100 recorded humidity page views and 10 related click events in a complete 14-day window, interpreted as events only. If below exposure floor, fix distribution; if >=100 views but <5 clicks, inspect task/offer fit. Merchant-confirmed $10 is the revenue gate; traffic goals do not substitute for it.

experiments.title: $100：复制已验证入口
experiments.status: conditional on current merchant evidence and $10 gate
experiments.action: Allocate most effort to the market/cluster with confirmed commission evidence; maintain the cooling pages already receiving clicks. Scale at most one genuinely useful page per existing daily cadence after source and demand gates. Track EPC using merchant clicks only, plus work hours and direct costs. Do not spend on ads before current net EPC is established.
experiments.gate: Current 30-day attributable net commission >=$100; repeat in a second non-overlapping 30-day window before calling it repeatable. If 100 merchant-reported clicks mature with zero shipped commission, check scope, eligibility, model and reporting delay before expanding. $100 is a target, not a guaranteed date.

daily_review: Read cached traffic source health; do not add overlapping snapshots
Compare last 7 complete UTC dates with previous 7; retain absolute counts and known gaps
Separate search, AI, direct and same-site referrers; do not call self-referrals new acquisition
Refresh private merchant statement when available; preserve shared-scope and currency limitations
Choose one distribution or buying-path repair; record minutes, cash cost, URL and result
weekly_review: Reconcile merchant statement, net reversals, payout and source dates
Review exposure before concluding demand failed; do not run underpowered A/B tests
Keep, adjust or stop each experiment using its predeclared gate
